id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataItem.description:
Read-only. The wrapped data object for the current row.
Property `obj` is an object containing data for the current row.

children.description: Read-only. The elements to render as children of this element.

columnProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the column to which the cell belongs.

gridProps.description: Read-only. Configuration of the grid to which the cell belongs.

content.description: Text to show on the cell

link.description: The link to direct to if the usage is link

contentMap.description:
Map of field value to display text. If undefined, display text will default to field value.
{@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpec} only works with {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting}

usage.description: Cell can be a button, link or plain text

prependedAvatar.description: Settings for avatar to be prepended to the content

appendedAvatar.description: Settings for avatar to be appended to the content

tooltip.description: Tooltip to show on text hover

tooltipMap.description:
Map of field value to display text. If undefined, display text will default to field value.
{@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpec} only works with {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting}

truncate.description: Whether the content should be truncated

truncatedCharacterLimit.description:
If provided, the inner text content will be truncated to this character limit. Only applicable when the truncate prop is true.
Useful to prevent rendering extremely long strings onto the DOM even when truncation is enabled.

capitalizeText.description:
Capitalize the field value.
Only works with UiSdlFieldBasedDynamicValueSpecParam

className.description: ClassName to be set on the cell. For styling purpose only.
